prompt: Painterly cinematic realism with Old-Master light, one warm grade, fine film grain. Wide shot. A single broad shaft of brilliant white light falling through a hole in thick clouds onto the plain, lighting the whole stepped brick tower from above, tiny workers on the ramps frozen and looking up, no figure in the light, centred in the frame. The figures are in silhouette, seen from behind. The subject is centred in the frame. Heavy storm light breaking open. Awe. The plain of Shinar soon after the flood: flat river land, wet clay, reeds, open fires and brick kilns, sun-baked bricks and black pitch, rough undyed linen and wool clothing. No stone temples, glass, iron, machinery, cranes, modern clothing or roads. No text, no logos.
